page.layout: One text column with a running head and page number at the top right. Quotation marks («) run down the right margin beside the lines of the quoted passage. Below the text: signature "e 5" at left and catchword "tan-" at right.
page.notes: The quotation marks (») in the right margin mark the passage quoted from Cicero's De Oratore, from "Nam si forte" to the end of the page; they are printed marks, not text, so they are not transcribed. The Greek word after "quam" is printed as ἀνατομικῶ; the final accent and letters are uncertain, so it is marked [?]. The word "uerbis" is printed with u as the initial vowel, normalised to "verbis". The page number is printed at the top right, and the running head is printed at the top left. The last line "e 5 tan-" is split: "e 5" is the signature at the foot left and "tan-" is the catchword at the foot right.
